system.description:
You thrust your palm forward at a creature you can see in range creating a blast of Chakra. Make a ranged Ninjutsu attack. On a hit you deal 5d6 force damage.

Eight Trigram. The blast of chakra is invisible. Unless the target has Chakra sight or Chakra sensing, you make this attack at advantage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you force the target creature to make a Constitution saving throw, becoming unable to mold Chakra until the beginning of their next turn.
